name: Circuit Gilles Villeneuve

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap way 136717490 "Circuit Gilles-Villeneuve" (ODbL, Overpass API), Taubin-smoothed
sources.width: Published/approximate: ~12-13 m typical (circuit roads on Île Notre-Dame), ~14 m pit straight, wider hairpin; OSM width=8 tag judged too narrow
sources.elevation: NRCan HRDEM mosaic 1 m DTM (lidar) via datacube WCS https://datacube.services.geo.ca/wrapper/ogc/elevation-hrdem-mosaic (coverage dtm), CGVD2013 heights
sources.camber: NRCan HRDEM 1 m lidar DTM edge-vs-centre samples
sources.pit: OpenStreetMap way 413000959 (pit lane): entry before the final chicane, exit after Virage Senna
sources.corners: Official F1 turn numbering from F1 live-timing circuit data (MultiViewer API circuits/23/2026) fitted to the centreline
sources.trim: Low-medium downforce: stop-and-go layout with long straights (Casino straight), teams trim wings below Spa level
sources.pitLimit: F1 Sporting Regulations default 80 km/h (Canadian GP event notes)
sources.pitLoss: F1 green-flag pit loss ~19.8 s from F1 live-timing derived circuit data (MultiViewer API)
sources.raceLaps: F1 2026 Canadian GP: 70 laps; 2026 sprint weekend (FIA/F1 2026 Sprint calendar), sprint 23 laps (100 km rule)

notes: Clockwise. Start/finish line placed at the bridge/gantry near the south end of the pit building (Esri World Imagery), ~300 m before the Turn 1 apex; approximate.
